_note: Config for the schedule-driven match pipeline (run_match_pipeline.sh). `mode` sets how far each match goes unattended: 'draft' = free Piper draft only (safest, no credits, no posting); 'produce' = spend ElevenLabs for the real render but DON'T post; 'publish' = produce + auto-upload to YouTube. TikTok/IG are NEVER auto-posted (a post_packet handoff is written for the attended post-social skill). The fact-check gate in /match-recap halts any match whose claims don't verify, so a bad match never reaches produce/publish. Flip mode to 'draft' anytime to fall back to review-first.
_visibility_note: Set to 'unlisted' for the first fully-autonomous QF (qf-01 Morocco v France, 2026-07-09) as a safety net — the result now comes from a deterministic ESPN fetch (fetch_result.py), but verify the first auto QF looks right, then flip back to 'public'.
